tasks.description: 1.1 Scaffold a new React project using Vite
1.2 Install PrimeReact, PrimeIcons, and required dependencies
1.3 Configure PrimeReact theme and structural CSS files
2.1 Create an API service layer for fetching (`GET`) and mutating (`POST`, `PUT`) user data
2.2 Define the User data structure and TypeScript interfaces/types (if using TS)
3.1 Build the `UserForm` component for user registration and editing
3.2 Build the `UserTable` component to list existing registered users
3.3 Create the main dashboard/layout integrating both components
4.1 Wire the `UserForm` to submit data to the backend API (`POST` for new, `PUT` for edits)
4.2 Wire the `UserTable` to fetch and render data from the backend API (`GET`)
4.3 Add success notifications and re-fetch mechanism upon successful saves
